column1: # B1's stocked monster placement, event-sourced -- what is actually where.
# DM-ONLY, same standing as B1_DM_NOTES_DO_NOT_READ.md and b1_wandering.tsv:
# tracked, published, never quoted to the player.
# APPEND-ONLY. `stock` places an individual once, from the master stocking
# table below (rolled 2026-08-15, never re-rolled -- see the DM notes'
# opening section). `hp`/`move`/`flee`/`die` are logged as they happen in
# play. Current position, hp and whether an individual still counts as
# "there" are all computed by tools/stocking.py, never stored twice.
# monster_id is per INDIVIDUAL (troglodyte_41a, not "the troglodytes"), so a
# wounded one that flees and is met again keeps its real remaining hp.
# area is the module's own room number, for citation back to the stocking
# table; x,y is the mapdb placement (the room's anchor at `stock` time, its
# real current cell after any move/flee).
